spec: Implement module fifo4x8(input wire clk, rst, wr_en, rd_en, input wire [7:0] wdata, output wire full, empty, output reg [2:0] count, output wire [7:0] rdata). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. FIFO depth 4, width 8. On reset empty=1, full=0, count=0. rdata is combinational oldest stored byte, or 0 when empty. At an edge accept write iff wr_en and pre-edge count<4; accept read iff rd_en and pre-edge count>0. Decisions use PRE-edge state independently: full+both requests only reads; empty+both requests only writes (no bypass). Accepted read removes oldest; accepted write appends wdata. Maintain count and order across pointer wrap.
